name: AG2
description: Builds multi-agent systems in Python with async agents, @tool functions, human-in-the-loop pauses, and a hub-and-channel Network for orchestrating agents across providers.

skills.name: Define Async Agents
skills.description: Creates Agent objects bound to a prompt and a model provider config, then runs a turn with ask() that returns an AgentReply.

skills.name: Register Python Tools
skills.description: Exposes plain Python functions to an agent with the @tool decorator so the model can invoke them during a conversation turn.

skills.name: Orchestrate Agent Networks
skills.description: Coordinates several agents over a hub with typed channels using the Network, the v1.0 replacement for classic GroupChat.

skills.name: Pause For Human Input
skills.description: Pauses a running agent to collect confirmation or missing information from a person before the workflow continues.

skills.name: Compact Context And Knowledge
skills.description: Layers persistent knowledge, context assembly, and history compaction onto an agent using opt-in harness primitives.
